name: whole-token matching
why: A substring scorer matched 'out' inside 'rollout'. Query terms are whole tokens, so this must return nothing.

name: stopwords carry no signal
why: Without stopword removal and IDF, 'the' produced a confident ranking over every record that happened to contain it.

name: distinctive term outranks common one
why: A term appearing in one record should rank that record first. IDF is what makes this hold when the corpus grows.

name: title match beats body match
why: Field weighting: a curated title is stronger evidence of aboutness than an incidental body mention.

name: no query terms returns nothing
why: An empty query is not a match-everything query.

name: unmatched term returns nothing
why: Absence of results is a valid, honest answer.

name: quality flags travel with results
why: Retrieval must not hide staleness or missing provenance behind a rank. Every hit carries its validation state.

name: results are bounded by default
why: An agent-facing retrieval tool must return a bounded ranked set. Returning every positive match grows with the corpus rather than with relevance.

name: an oversized limit is capped, not honoured
why: A caller asking for 9999 results should be silently capped rather than handed the whole corpus.
